lines.text: &fYour Minestar friends, wherever they are playing.
&7&aGreen&7 — on this server. &bAqua&7 — online in another modpack. &7Gray — offline. &6★&7 — in your FTB party. Hover a name for where they are or when they were last seen.

&7The drop-down changes the view: &fBy server&7 groups friends by the pack they are playing, then &fOnline first&7, &fA-Z&7, &fZ-A&7 and &fFTB team&7 (party members first). ⟳ reloads the list from Minestar.
&fOnline players&7 lists everyone on this server, friends marked with &d❤&7. Pick someone and press &eAdd friend&7 to send a request &8- they need a Minestar account.
&fRequests&7 shows requests waiting either way: answer incoming ones with &a✔&7 or &c✖&7, or withdraw one you sent with &c✖&7.
&7Pick a friend to see their face, Minestar level, status, group, Prime, playtime and rewards. Hover the level for the XP still needed, and a reward for its rarity and description.
&7&eTPA&7 and &eTPA here&7 work only while the friend is on this server.
&7&eInvite to team&7 invites them into your FTB party, creating one if you have none. It needs them on this server and is hidden in the FTB team view.
&7&eRemove friend&7 asks for a second click to confirm, so a misclick does not cost you a friend.
